description: What each of the app's windows (main, and w1, w2... made for a tab dragged out or brought back: T6.2) may ask the shell for: its own commands, the open/save dialogs, a yes-or-no question, setting the window title, setting its light or dark (Appearance), its own title bar's buttons and drag area (minimize, maximize, close, move: T4.10), and closing itself once the page has saved.
